tool.name: 3DTrees: SmartTile
tool.description: Tile, merge and remap point clouds

param.label: Prod-merged resolution (m)
param.help: Voxel size in metres, or full for every point (adds OriginalPointIndex, as needed by ForestStructure).

validator.message: Enter a size in metres, for example 0.1, or full.

param.name: input_files
param.label: Input LAZ/LAS files
param.help: One or more source point clouds in a projected CRS in metres.

param.label: Tiling threshold (MB)
param.help: A single input smaller than this is not split into tiles.

param.label: Resolution 1 (m)
param.help: Fine subsampling resolution.

param.label: Resolution 2 (m)
param.help: Coarse subsampling resolution.

param.label: Keep existing instances whole
param.help: Optional: an existing tree ID field, for example PredInstance_SAT. Every tree is then kept whole in one tile, for species prediction.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.

param.name: input_segmented
param.label: Segmented tiles
param.help: Segmented predictions on the coarse tiles of one tiling run.

param.name: input_res1
param.label: Target-resolution subsampled tiles
param.help: Fine tiles of the same run; the predictions are transferred onto them.

param.name: input_original_laz
param.label: Original LAZ/LAS files
param.help: Optional: also write the originals with the predictions, and prod-merged products.

param.name: tile_bounds_json
param.label: Tile bounds JSON
param.help: From the same tiling run.

param.label: Instance dimension
param.help: For example PredInstance_SAT or PredInstance_FM.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.

param.name: mode
param.label: Tree sidecar files
param.help: RayCloudTools tree tables are filtered together with the tiles.

param.name: enabled
param.label: Cross-tile merging
param.help: Merge matching instances that cross tile borders.

param.name: enabled
param.label: Small cluster reassignment
param.help: Give small instances the ID of the nearest larger instance.

param.name: input_tree_files
param.label: Tree files from 3dtrees_raycloudtools
param.help: The *_trees.txt and *_trees_info.txt of every segmented tile.

param.name: collection
param.label: Segmented files collection
param.help: One collection per model, for example the merged SAT tiles.

param.label: Dimension allowlist
param.help: Comma-separated; empty transfers all extra dimensions.

param.name: merged_file
param.label: Merged LAZ/COPC LAZ file
param.help: For example the merged tiles of Filter/Merge.

param.label: Prediction resolution (m)
param.help: Voxel size of the predictions; every original point must lie within the voxel diagonal.

param.label: Match within the same instance
param.help: For species predictions on whole-instance tiles: copy values only from the point's own tree.

param.name: original_with_predictions
param.label: Original-with-predictions files
param.help: Original files that already contain prediction dimensions.

collection.name: prod_merged_outputs
collection.label: ${tool.name}: Prod-merged LAZ/COPC products
collection.filter: (operation['task'] == "create_merged_file" and ("laz" in operation['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['merged_output_formats'])) or (operation['task'] in ("remap", "merge") and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and (operation['task'] == "remap" or operation['input_original_laz']) and ("laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats']))

collection.name: prod_merged_ply_outputs
collection.label: ${tool.name}: Prod-merged PLY products
collection.filter: (operation['task'] == "create_merged_file" and "ply" in operation['merged_output_formats']) or (operation['task'] in ("remap", "merge") and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and (operation['task'] == "remap" or operation['input_original_laz']) and "ply" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'])

tool.help:
SmartTile prepares and post-processes point-cloud predictions for the 3Dtrees workflow. Inputs must use a projected CRS in metres.
**Tile and subsample** splits LAZ/LAS files into buffered tiles and writes two subsampled collections, a tiling preview and the tile bounds JSON. With **Keep existing instances whole**, every tree of that ID field stays whole in one tile, for species prediction.
**Filter/Merge segmented tiles** transfers the predictions onto the target-resolution tiles, keeps each tree in the tile that owns it, merges trees across tile borders and removes buffer duplicates. Give it the tile bounds JSON of the same run. With original files it also writes them with the predictions, and prod-merged products. RayCloudTools tree files are filtered together with the tiles.
**Remap predictions to originals** copies the prediction dimensions of one or more segmented collections, or of one merged file, onto the original files. Every original point must be covered.
**Create prod-merged file** writes LAZ, COPC LAZ or PLY products from original files that already carry predictions. Resolution **full** keeps every point and adds OriginalPointIndex for ForestStructure.
